summary: A link points to a bookmark the document does not have.
A field (REF, PAGEREF, HYPERLINK \l) refers to a bookmark the document does not have.
A field shows an error result ("Error! …") instead of its value.
A picture's image is not in the document, so it shows as an empty frame.
A footnote or endnote reference has no note text in the document.
A heading has no text, so it shows as an empty entry in navigation and tables of contents.
A table row spans fewer or more columns than the table's grid.
A picture or chart has no alternative text for screen readers.
A font is not available here and is drawn with a substitute, so lines may break differently.
Tracked insertions or deletions are not accepted or rejected yet.
A code was found more than 100 times; the rest are counted, not listed.
